vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.96

The tickerdb skill bundle is a legitimate integration for a market data service. It provides comprehensive instructions for an AI agent to interact with the TickerDB API (api.tickerdb.com), including authentication flows, watchlist management, and automated market reporting via cron jobs. The skill follows standard OpenClaw patterns for environment variable management and user-authorized account setup without any evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it connects to TickerDB via a single API key, its runtime instructions match that purpose, and it has no install step or unrelated privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and declared requirement (TICKERDB_KEY) match the SKILL.md which describes calls to https://api.tickerdb.com. No unrelated environment variables, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions focus on authenticating (email + code flow), populating a watchlist, and optionally setting up a daily report. They explicitly call the TickerDB API endpoints and do not instruct reading other system files or unrelated env vars. Note: the onboarding asks users for email and verification code and to show/save the returned apiKey — this is appropriate for the described auth flow but is a privacy consideration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files; nothing is downloaded or written during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (TICKERDB_KEY) is required and declared as primaryEnv. The SKILL.md uses that key for Bearer auth and does not reference other secrets or unrelated credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill expects the platform to persist the API key if the user consents. The skill is user-invocable and allows autonomous invocation (disable-model-invocation:false) — this is the platform default but means the agent can call TickerDB automatically using the stored key when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it will ask for your email to perform a standard auth flow, display an apiKey returned by TickerDB, and — if you confirm — the platform will store that key so the agent can call the TickerDB API. Before installing: (1) confirm you trust tickerdb.com and understand their privacy/billing terms; (2) be aware that saving the API key allows the agent (and any autonomous skill invocation) to make API calls using your key; (3) if you prefer tighter control, do not allow the skill to persist the key or revoke it later via the TickerDB dashboard. If you want additional safety, verify the TickerDB documentation and limit the API key's permissions or usage/quota on their dashboard.
